caption: The drawing depicts a stylized, possibly wooden or carved male figure standing on a rectangular platform or base. The figure is wearing a blue suit with red accents, a black wide-brimmed hat, and decorative boots with patterns in tones of brown, blue, and red. The figure has a beard and mustache, and his face is outlined and shaded with dark and light tones of brown, pink, and cream. His left arm is bent at the elbow with a closed hand, while the right arm is raised with the hand in an open position. In front of the figure, on the same platform, are two small animals resembling cattle or oxen, both with bodies decorated in red, yellow, and black stripes, pale pink legs, and black hooves. The horns of the animals are black, and their faces have red and white patches. The background of the drawing is left plain and light in color, with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Bulto of San Ysidro
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
